say:2:1111305001:0.text: Oh no, what happened to her? We have to stop the bleeding! Come with me! I have some herbs back home!
say:2:1111305001:0.source_cn: 哎呀，这位大姐姐怎么受伤了？得赶快止血才行！我家有草药！

say:3:1111305002:0.text: What a kind little girl! Thank you so much...
say:3:1111305002:0.source_cn: 谢谢，你真是个善良的孩子……

say:4:1111305003:0.text: Where did Mama put those herbs? I just need a second to find them...
say:4:1111305003:0.source_cn: 咦，妈妈把草药放哪了？我得好好找一找。

say:6:1111305005:0.text: I can't find them... The house has gotten too messy to find anything since Mama's not here...
say:6:1111305005:0.source_cn: 不行啊……妈妈不在，家里乱糟糟的，什么都找不到……

say:8:1111305006:0.text: This must be how you feel, Chippy. If it weren't for Dolly, your room would be a total pigsty!
say:8:1111305006:0.source_cn: 和满满一样嘛，要不是多莉经常帮忙收拾，满满的房间连个落...

say:11:1111305007:0.text: Your room's no different! The floor's practically covered with potions and notebooks!
say:11:1111305007:0.source_cn: 你的房间不也一样吗？魔法药剂堆得到处都是！

say:12:1111305008:1.text: Hey, it's not my fault! I was born a hamster...
say:12:1111305008:1.source_cn: 没办法……谁叫我是一只仓鼠呢？

say:13:1111305009:1.text: Don't worry, little girl. We'll help you look for them!
say:13:1111305009:1.source_cn: 小朋友，你不要着急，我们来帮你。

say:14:1111305010:1.text: Or rather, Magister Merlin, can you help? Dolly taught you how to organize and tidy up, right?
say:14:1111305010:1.source_cn: 梅林！交给你啦，多莉说她曾经教过你如何整理。
say:14:1111305010:1.male: Or rather, Magister Merlin, can you help? Dolly taught you how to organize and tidy up, right?
say:14:1111305010:1.female: Or rather, Magister Merlin, can you help? Dolly taught you how to organize and tidy up, right?

say:16:1111305011:0.text: Come on, Magister. This is easier than magic.
say:16:1111305011:0.source_cn: 这比魔法简单多啦，你一定没问题！
say:16:1111305011:0.male: Come on, Magister. This is easier than magic.
say:16:1111305011:0.female: Come on, Magister. This is easier than magic.

say:18:1111305012:0.text: Do you really expect me to move all this stuff with my tiny hands, Magister Merlin?
say:18:1111305012:0.source_cn: 梅林，你看我的手这么小，根本拿不住这些东西。
say:18:1111305012:0.male: Do you really expect me to move all this stuff with my tiny hands, Magister Merlin?
say:18:1111305012:0.female: Do you really expect me to move all this stuff with my tiny hands, Magister Merlin?

say:19:1111305013:0.text: You know I'd love to help, but all I can give is moral support right now!
say:19:1111305013:0.source_cn: 我也很想帮你……但是，我只能帮你加油了！你一定没问题！
